mapper.select:
SELECT f.id, f.app_id AS appId, a.app_name AS appName, f.original_name AS originalName, f.content_type AS contentType, f.file_size AS fileSize, f.file_hash AS fileHash, f.uploader_id AS uploaderId, f.uploader_username AS uploaderUsername, f.created_at AS createdAt FROM sys_file f LEFT JOIN sys_app a ON a.app_id = f.app_id AND a.deleted = 0
ORDER BY f.created_at DESC, f.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_file (app_id, original_name, stored_name, storage_path, content_type, file_size, file_hash, uploader_id, uploader_username) VALUES (#{appId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{storagePath}, #{contentType}, #{fileSize}, #{fileHash}, #{uploaderId}, #{uploaderUsername})
